recent_actions.Action: Artificial intelligence and robotics are changing the private security industry, but they will not replace bodyguards, according to Radovan Opitz, founder and chief executive of Dubai-based Falcon Shield. Opitz says AI can support tasks such as facial recognition, but 'the presence or patrolling, or even being in those places physically, it's irreplaceable'. He believes demand for security services will continue to grow across the Gulf, with maritime security emerging as a key opportunity following the disruption to shipping through the Strait of Hormuz during the Iran war. Falcon Shield plans to recruit up to 150 personnel by the end of the year, expand across the UAE and launch operations
